title: The Effects of Nutritional Supplementation and Drug Abuse on HIV
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to determine whether supplementation with multivitamins and selenium will delay disease progression in HIV infected individuals in Botswana. The study will also assess how drug abuse modifies the effect of nutritional supplementation on HIV disease progression.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* HIV infected
* CD4 count greater than 350 cells/mm3
* Identified from the Infectious Disease Care Clinic
* Body mass index greater than 18 for women and greater than 18.5 for men

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current AIDS-defining condition
* Currently participating in another clinical trial
* Pregnant or intends to become pregnant during the study
